source.name: Purchase Invoice Reconciliation Latam for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

mapping.summary: Receives and reconciles electronic purchase documents for Latin American countries
claims: Automated reception of electronic invoices, credit notes and debit notes (DTE)
Real-time connection to country tax connectors
Reconciles XML/JSON amounts against purchase order amounts and flags differences
Automatically creates and posts purchase invoices linked to POs
Mass posting of reconciled invoices via periodic tasks
Shows DTE status, the purchase registry and events per period
Stores XML/JSON and PDF files in BC
Imports electronic certificate for connection to legal entities
Tolerance settings for amount matching by document type
Azure storage account integration for attachments
Sends and receives acceptance and claim events in real time
Multiple countries in one BC instance
